mapper.update: UPDATE notify_plan SET recipient_upper_user_id=#{upperUserId} WHERE id=#{id} AND recipient_upper_user_id IS NULL AND status IN (0,3)
UPDATE notify_plan SET title=#{title}, content=#{content}, subject_location=#{location}, timeline_id=#{timelineId} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN (0,3)
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notify_plan WHERE source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND rule_key=#{ruleKey} AND subject_starts_at=#{anchor} AND status=1)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(generation),0) FROM notify_plan WHERE source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND timeline_id=#{timelineId} AND rule_key=#{ruleKey}
